title: Answer: no separate account of a self, whose unity is the unity of entangled conscious moments

statements.text: Orch OR gives no separate theory of the self. A sense of self is listed among what consciousness implies, and the unity of conscious content is placed in the physics of one moment: superposed microtubules in many neurons, joined by gap junctions, entangle and reduce together, which allows unity and binding of conscious content. In the conscious pilot model this zone of dendritic synchrony moves around the brain.
statements.scope: the 2014 review Consciousness in the universe

sources.quote: Consciousness also implies a sense of self, feelings, choice, control of voluntary behavior, memory, thought, language
This allows unity and binding of conscious content
The model suggests consciousness literally moves around the brain in a mobile synchronized zone
